title: Power System Analysis & Operation Laboratory
description: Ten experiments in two halves. Five on live hardware — transmission line trainers, protection relays, induction motors — run before the mid-semester exam, then five MATLAB simulation experiments after it. The hardware half is where I meet a laboratory bench for the first time.

parts.title: Hardware Experiments
parts.description: Five experiments on energised equipment. Voltage regulation and the PV curve of a transmission line model, overcurrent protection of an induction motor, the Ferranti effect and shunt compensation on an HVAC line, the four protection relays, and ZIP load characteristics.

parts.title: MATLAB Simulation Experiments
parts.description: Five simulation experiments taken up after the mid-semester exam. These pages will be written once the experiment list is issued — the slots below are placeholders so the shape of the course is visible now rather than appearing later.
